verdict.rationale: Gumloop's public API documents creating and updating agents, Gumloop's workflow unit (gumloop-docs-15, gumloop-docs-24). The Python SDK exposes an agents resource client (gumloop-docs-50), so an agent-driven caller can author and modify these programmatically with API keys or OAuth (gumloop-docs-11, gumloop-docs-22). However, nothing shows that activation (enabling scheduled, app or webhook triggers) can be done through the API rather than the UI, and no OpenAPI spec was found (gumloop-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented API endpoint to activate or configure triggers and schedules, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end create/update/activate flow.
